note: Environmental data for ARES. verified=false means the numbers were carried over from the prototype and have not yet been re-checked against the paper.

radiation.label: Galactic cosmic ray absorbed dose rate at Gale (MSL/RAD, about 300 sols, 2012–2013)
radiation.measuredInside: Measured by the RAD instrument on the Curiosity rover, not by a suit-worn dosimeter.
radiation.verifyNote: The paper exists and reports both absorbed dose and dose equivalent, but these figures have not yet been re-checked against it. Dose equivalent (mSv) is the quantity used for astronaut limits and still needs to be added.

pending: Atmospheric pressure and temperature: no sourced values are shown yet. They will be added from published Curiosity data with dates and units. No live Mars weather and no real-time telemetry are used.
